cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Validation Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Primary responsibility is preparation of validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Work with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Interface with the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to obtain the equipment, controls, and installation support documents necessary for protocol development.
Field execution/testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents. This will include (but is not limited to) I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of the personnel involved during on-site qualification. This would include the various engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies.
Specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software necessary to perform in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner. This will include field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMP's, Validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines and related FDA publications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance positive interpersonal relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to develop validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents; good writing and grammar skills and attention to detail are essential.
Experience reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Understanding of computer system validation including knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Familiarity with industry accepted practices for documenting test results, recording of deviations, and deviation resolutions.
Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Minimum of a four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, science or 5 to 7 years of related experience.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Must be willing and capable to climb ladders and to enter restrictive spaces.
Confined space entry training for potential entry into confined spaces within [Company name masked] supplied equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Travel 25 to 35% to customer sites to perform validation testing of [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Good troubleshooting skills. Prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service is desirable.

Primary responsibility is preparation of validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Work with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Interface with the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to obtain the equipment, controls, and installation support documents necessary for protocol development.
Field execution/testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents. This will include (but is not limited to) I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of the personnel involved during on-site qualification. This would include the various engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies.
Specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software necessary to perform in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner. This will include field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMP's, Validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines and related FDA publications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance positive interpersonal relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0101.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in developing validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents. Strong writing, grammar, and attention to detail are essential.
Proven track record in reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Ability to travel 25 to 35% to customer sites to perform validation testing of [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Proficiency in industry accepted practices for documenting test results, recording of deviations, and deviation resolutions.
Exceptional communication skills and demonstrated ability to present validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Strong troubleshooting abilities. Substantial prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service is desirable.
Must be willing and capable of climbing ladders and entering restrictive spaces.
Advanced knowledge of computer system validation, including deep knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Minimum of a four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, science required; advanced degree strongly preferred, or minimum 7 years of directly related experience.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Confined space entry training is required for potential entry into confined spaces within [Company name masked] supplied equipment.
cond_0101.values: We value acting with integrity and keeping the interests of others in view. We aim to create positive outcomes through work that is respectful, fair, and responsible.
cond_0101.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.

cond_0112.intro: We are looking for a Validation Engineer to join our team. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of validation processes and control systems.
cond_0112.responsibilities:
Primary responsibility is preparation of validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Work with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Interface with the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to obtain the equipment, controls, and installation support documents necessary for protocol development.
Field execution/testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents. This will include (but is not limited to) I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of the personnel involved during on-site qualification. This would include the various engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies.
Specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software necessary to perform in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner. This will include field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMP's, Validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines and related FDA publications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance positive interpersonal relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0112.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to develop validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents; good writing and grammar skills and attention to detail are essential.
Experience reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Understanding of computer system validation including knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Familiarity with industry accepted practices for documenting test results, recording of deviations, and deviation resolutions.
Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Minimum of a four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, science or 5 to 7 years of related experience.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Willing and capable to climb ladders and enter restrictive spaces.
Confined space entry training for potential entry into confined spaces within [Company name masked] supplied equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Travel 25 to 35% to customer sites to perform validation testing of [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Good troubleshooting skills; prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service.
cond_0112.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Work with control system programmers to prepare validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Coordinate with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Collaborate with [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to gather the equipment, controls, and installation support documents needed for protocol development.
Support field execution and testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents, including I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of personnel involved during on-site qualification, including engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from equipment manufacturing companies.
Work with the team to specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software needed for in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner, including field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMPs, validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines, and related FDA publications.
Build and maintain positive working relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0207.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to develop validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents; good writing, grammar, and attention to detail are essential.
Experience reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Willingness and ability to travel 25–35% to customer sites to perform validation testing.
Familiarity with industry-accepted practices for documenting test results, recording deviations, and resolving deviations.
Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Understanding of computer system validation, including knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Minimum four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, or science; or 5–7 years of related experience.
Valid driver's license.
Ability and willingness to climb ladders and enter restrictive spaces.
Confined space entry training for potential entry into confined spaces within supplied equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Good troubleshooting skills; prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service.

cond_0371.responsibilities:
Primary responsibility is preparation of validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Work with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Interface with the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to obtain the equipment, controls, and installation support documents necessary for protocol development.
Field execution/testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents. This will include (but is not limited to) I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of the personnel involved during on-site qualification. This would include the various engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies.
Specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software necessary to perform in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner. This will include field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMP's, Validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines and related FDA publications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance positive interpersonal relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0371.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in developing validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents. Strong writing, grammar, and attention to detail are essential.
Proven track record in reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Ability to travel 25 to 35% to customer sites to perform validation testing of [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Proficiency in industry accepted practices for documenting test results, recording of deviations, and deviation resolutions.
Exceptional communication skills and demonstrated ability to present validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Strong troubleshooting abilities. Substantial prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service is desirable.
Must be willing and capable of climbing ladders and entering restrictive spaces.
Advanced knowledge of computer system validation, including deep knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Minimum of a four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, science required; advanced degree strongly preferred, or minimum 7 years of directly related experience.

Demonstrated expertise in developing validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents; strong writing, grammar, and attention to detail are essential.
Proven track record in reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Advanced knowledge of computer system validation, including GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.

cond_0401.intro: We are looking for a Validation Engineer to join our team. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience with validation protocols, control systems, and field testing.
cond_0401.responsibilities:
Primary responsibility is preparation of validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Work with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Interface with the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to obtain the equipment, controls, and installation support documents necessary for protocol development.
Field execution/testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents. This will include (but is not limited to) I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of the personnel involved during on-site qualification. This would include the various engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies.
Specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software necessary to perform in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner. This will include field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMPs, Validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines and related FDA publications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance positive interpersonal relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0401.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to develop validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents; good writing and grammar skills and attention to detail are essential.
Experience reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Understanding of computer system validation including knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Minimum of a four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, science, or 5 to 7 years of related experience.
Valid driver's license.
Willing and able to climb ladders and enter restrictive spaces.
Confined space entry training for potential entry into confined spaces within [Company name masked] supplied equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with industry accepted practices for documenting test results, recording deviations, and deviation resolutions.
Good troubleshooting skills; prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service.
Willingness to travel 25 to 35% to customer sites to perform validation testing.
cond_0401.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0401.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

cond_0436.responsibilities:
Primary responsibility is preparation of validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents for [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Work with [Company name masked]'s control system programmers to develop and execute factory acceptance software test documents.
Work as an integral member of a project team.
Interface with the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies and internal departments to obtain the equipment, controls, and installation support documents necessary for protocol development.
Field execution/testing of approved validation protocols (IQ/OQ) and commissioning documents. This will include (but is not limited to) I/O forcing, alarm testing, sequence testing, PLC diagnostics, and PID loop performance testing.
Coordinate the efforts of the personnel involved during on-site qualification. This would include the various engineering disciplines from within [Company name masked] and/or personnel from the [Company name masked] equipment manufacturing companies.
Specify, obtain, and maintain hardware and software necessary to perform in-house and on-site validation testing.
Prepare documents of field visits in a timely and professional manner. This will include field reports, daily labor logs, invoices, and expense reports.
Keep current with latest cGMP's, Validation technology and procedures, ISPE guidelines and related FDA publications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance positive interpersonal relationships with staff members of the [Company name masked] Group worldwide.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0436.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to develop validation protocols (IQ and OQ), validation reports, and factory acceptance test documents; good writing and grammar skills and attention to detail are essential.
Experience reading and interpreting electric and pneumatic controls, technical design documents, and PLC code.
Understanding of computer system validation including knowledge of GAMP 5 and CFR 21 Part 11.
Familiarity with industry accepted practices for documenting test results, recording of deviations, and deviation resolutions.
Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting validation results to customer project teams (QA, validation, project management, etc.).
Minimum of a four-year degree in engineering, engineering technology, science or 5 to 7 years of related experience.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Willing and capable to climb ladders and enter restrictive spaces.
Confined space entry training for potential entry into confined spaces within [Company name masked] supplied equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Travel 25 to 35% to customer sites to perform validation testing of [Company name masked] equipment and control systems.
Good troubleshooting skills; prior experience in control system programming, commissioning, calibration, I/O forcing, PID loop tuning, and/or equipment service.
